testOnlyKeys: Every secret here (testOnlySecrets, the signing keys behind every signature) is a synthetic TEST ONLY scalar: keccak256 of a label containing 'TEST ONLY', reduced. Never use them for anything else. Networks, corridors, nonces and digests are fixtures.

descriptor.publicKeys: The account's public keys in the SDK's public form (stdlib PublicKeys): ivpk_m as a point (x, y), the nullifier, outgoing-viewing, tagging, message-signing and fallback master keys as hashPublicKey digests. Both pinned SDKs carry six master keys, five of them only as digests; no isInfinite flag enters any hash.
derivation: saltedInitializationHash = poseidon2([SALTED_INITIALIZATION_HASH, salt, initializationHash, deployer, immutablesHash = 0])
publicKeysHash = poseidon2([PUBLIC_KEYS_HASH, npkMHash, ivpkMHash, ovpkMHash, tpkMHash, mspkMHash, fbpkMHash])
addressPoint = preaddress * G + ivpk_m (Grumpkin); address = addressPoint.x
descriptor.poseidon2: BN254 Poseidon2 sponge (t = 4, rate 3), poseidon2([s, ...]) = Noir/bb.js poseidon2_hash over the field list with the separator first

recipientMessage.decided: 2026-10-24/25 by the product owner; replaces the compatibility spike's provisional plain mod r
rule: d = the EIP-712 digest of the inner struct (keccak256(0x1901 || domainSeparator || hashStruct))
the account signs m as a 32-byte big-endian field element under SchnorrAccount's scheme

schnorr.challenge: e = poseidon2([SCHNORR_CHALLENGE_DST, R.x, P.x, P.y, m]); accept iff P on curve, s != 0, e != 0, R = s*G + e*P != O
schnorr.signatureEncoding: s || e, 32 bytes each, big-endian (64 bytes); canonical s < q, e < r
schnorr.testOnlyNonce: the vectors' nonce k = OS2IP(sha512('xochi-spec TEST ONLY schnorr nonce' || sk || m)) mod q; any valid nonce verifies the same way

recipientMessage.tooling: The recipient's own tooling rebuilds the full typed preimage, computes d, applies the wrapper and signs m. It never signs a digest or field value supplied by Xochi.

reduction.name: (r + 1) * 2^128: truncation to 256 bits gives r + 1 (-> 1), wide gives 2^128
kmax * r (largest multiple of r below 2^384)

acknowledgements.domain: Domain (binding): every acknowledgement is a statement by the recipient about one binding, so it is scoped to that binding's environment, network and source chain. Primary type and purpose string separate the types inside the domain; a dedicated domain would add no separation those two do not.

rules: bindingDigest = the RecipientBinding EIP-712 digest both parties signed

BackupPersistenceAck.backupCommitment = keccak256(randomized encrypted backup bytes); backupFormatId = keccak256(UTF8("xochi.shielded.backup-format.v1")) = 0xe37c67f007c5a5bbebbc6c5b9aefd99f252b2cc121e3fc9a269801940f605348; neither value contains plaintext
